mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased wage pressures and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > previous month & UNRATE < previous month
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and healthy labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS and UNRATE both show the specified trends.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < -0.5%.
